Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `main` @ `b79b58cf49a9555c4152d764efa6aaec782fc2d9`. The "Integration branch mismatch" line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so this is not blocked.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
- No code changes. Replace the whole content of `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` with exactly these three lines, followed by one trailing LF:
  ```
  status: ok
  run_id: 42136542904
  updated-by: ai-pipeline
  ```
  This is the same as `printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 42136542904\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n' > tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

## Data structures affected
- None. This is a plain-text canary fixture.

## API or interface changes
- None.

## Automation / scheduler wiring (§20.E)
- No new script. Only one existing file changes.
- No scheduler or PR-push wiring is needed.
- No long-running supervisor is needed.
- No database work.
- No entry is needed in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`.

## Decisions
### D1 — Overwrite the whole file instead of editing one line
- Chosen: rewrite the full file with the three specified lines.
- Alternatives considered: change only the second line, which currently reads `decompose-run: 41445772297`.
- Why: the issue says to replace the file completely, and a full rewrite guarantees an exact match, including the trailing newline.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or external input is involved. The file holds only static test text.
- Abuse case: none. The scope is limited to a single file.

## Risks and edge cases
- Conflict note: the file currently contains `status: ok` and `decompose-run: 41445772297`. The issue wants the second line replaced with `run_id: ...` and a third line added. This matches the issue's request to overwrite.
- The file must end with exactly one `\n`, with no CRLF line endings and no extra blank line.
- No other file may change, including changelog or `agents.d` entries.

## Testing considerations
- `cat -A tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` should show three lines, each ending in `$`.
- `git diff --stat` should list only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

## Pre-execution self-check
- Scope matches the issue, the file exists, and no clarification is needed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies one overwrite of an existing file and forbids any other change, so the scope stays exactly as requested. Following §6 Core Priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed), the complete option is a byte-exact rewrite, and it costs no more than a partial edit.
